rationale: The workflow's phpunit job has no explicit timeout, so a stuck or runaway matrix job can consume runner time up to the default limit. The P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern (bound jobs with a custom timeout) is evidence-supported: it reports reduced runaway VM consumption and requires representative successful-duration history, which exists in the repository CI history (5 recent runs, roughly 21-63 minutes). Adding timeout-minutes: 120 gives an explicit budget with roughly 2x headroom over the observed maximum, preserving all build and test coverage because normal runs complete well within the limit while only runaway jobs are bounded. This is a minimal, workflow-scoped change that adds no privileges, secrets, network access, or deployment steps, and it does not alter the matrix, services, steps, or required checks.
